notes.title: Patch v0.4
notes.content:
Hello climbers!

We’ve given the game’s menus a fresh new look! This update focuses on improving the visual style and clarity of the user interface to make your experience smoother and more immersive.

Changes:

✨ Completely restyled main menu and in-game menus for a more modern and cohesive look

🧭 Improved navigation elements for better usability

🖱️ Enhanced button feedback and layout consistency across screens

🎨 Updated color palette and visual polish to match the game’s aesthetic

notes.title: Patch v0.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where two players could simultaneously interact with a pushable stone.
[*] Resolved a bug where characters would get stuck on a pushable stone after pressing and holding the interact key.
[*] Fixed a problem preventing players from acquiring certain skills and deleting portals.
[*] Addressed an issue where the glider part could not be collected.
[*] Moving fans now properly block player movement when intended.
[*] Resolved a movement issue for clients after solving the DIAL parkour puzzle.
[*] Fixed desynced gray stones blocking progress in the parkour puzzle.
[*] Chinatown elevator desync issue fixed, ensuring the parkour fully resets properly.
[*] Fixed a problem with the ancient stone where character movement would lock even if another player triggered the stone.
[*] Improved camera angles in the "Lightning Zeus" parkour challenge.
[*] Adjusted the collision boxes for discs in the Zeus parkour, and ensured server activation works consistently.
[*] Fixed a bug where after dropping a stone in the first parkour, the "E" interaction prompt failed to appear after respawning.
[*] Increased laser speed and extended their range for better gameplay balance.
[*] Fixed an issue where cannonballs failed to launch after collision.
[*] Resolved a bug in snowy areas where players could bypass walls using air injection.
[*] Fixed a bug where using the "ALT + Y" key granted skills to all players.
[*] Portals can now be deleted and no longer stay reusable indefinitely.
[*] Resolved an issue where some skills (e.g., glider parts) could not be picked up.
[*] Shortened the on/off duration of electricity in the parkour with electric controls.
[*] Fixed the moving fan walls to work properly as intended.
[*] Added proper breathing sounds when using stones.
[*] Fixed the elevator laser issue where rotating it took too long.
[*] Resolved issues when using skills or solving puzzles during F5 tests.
[*] Reduced the collision box size of swinging balls, which was previously too large.
[*] Fixed a bug where the client couldn’t move after solving the DIAL parkour puzzle.
[*] Resolved an issue where alt-tabbing caused the screen to lose focus, and holding the right mouse button made the character rotate.
[*] Mouse sensitivity settings can now be adjusted properly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.2
notes.content:
- The issue of not being able to select a skill again from the Skill menu after using a Skill has been fixed.
- Fixed the issue of some tracks not fully resetting
- New upscaling methods such as NVIDIA DLSS, AMD FSR, INTEL XeSS have been added to the game.
- The Alpha Version of Main UI Of Game has been added.
- The Volume difference between in-game sounds has been resolved and the sounds have been made adjustable from the settings menu.
- Turkish Language Added to the Game.
